# T-2: Bind directives

## Goal
Make next-action and dispatcher target-sensitive outputs derive their executable guard data from FlowTargetBinding.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Directive serialization exposes CLI-generated execution data without requiring the worker to assemble runId, Issue, or spec strings.
- targetGuardArgs is removed from the public worker prompt contract or generated only as a binding-owned internal detail.

## Implementation Notes
Update src/flow/lib/next-action-directive.js and src/flow/lib/run-dispatch.js. Preserve the single NextActionDirective routing authority.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for directive JSON and dispatcher work prompt or command construction.
